note: Generated by scripts/siteCredentialScopeLock.ts. Locks SITE_CLIENT_MANAGER_TOOLS (src/agent/capture/siteGenesis.ts) — the exact toolAllowlist genesis mints into every new site's scoped bearer, and the allowlist reconcileSiteClientManagerCredentials re-mints EVERY existing tenant's credential from. Regenerate deliberately with `npm run scope:update` when the allowlist intentionally changes, and when you do: this file changing is not enough on its own — every already-registered tenant is still running on the OLD scope until someone re-runs the `site-credential-reconciler` Cloud Run Job with `--apply` (see docs/mcp-scoped-bearer-auth.md). Widening the constant without that rotation just changes what NEW sites get; narrowing it without warning the fleet is how a tenant's working workflow call turns into a silent 401.
